'''Rihn Utrila''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was the triplet of [[Dai Utrila]] and [[Koya Utrila]], and a servant to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]]. Following Popara's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Utrila and her sisters entered the service of Popara's son [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]], and she became addicted to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]].
